answer: Require each identity to build one sable chain of sequential work: every completed task is sealed with an onyx stamp that seeds the next task, so the chain can only grow one link at a time. Each link also earns a plume token tied to that stamp, and payout grows with the square of chain length. A farm cannot parallelize or pool chains, because splitting one history into ten short chains earns far less than one long chain, while a single honest agent grows one deep chain and is paid for its depth.
